displayName: MDO - Illicit OAuth App Consent (Consent Phishing)

queryCondition.queryText:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType in ("Consent to application", "Add delegated permission grant")
| extend AppName = tostring(RawEventData.ObjectName)
| project Timestamp, ReportId, AccountObjectId, AccountDisplayName, ActionType, AppName, IPAddress, IsAdminOperation, UserAgent

alertTemplate.title: Illicit OAuth app consent (consent phishing)
alertTemplate.description: A user granted delegated consent to an OAuth application - the key event in consent-phishing / illicit-grant attacks that give an attacker persistent access to mail and files.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Review the app, publisher and requested scopes (Mail.Read, Files.ReadWrite, offline_access). If illicit, revoke the app's consent and refresh tokens, and correlate the user with recent phishing activity.
